assumptions.decision: Every fork below is decided by default; openDecisions stays empty.

assumptions.specRef: §2 'У формі, відкритій із каталогу, додай «Змінити список»'
assumptions.decision: Show 'Змінити список' whenever the form was reached through GoalListPicker: the catalog (goals-catalog.tsx:86-103) and the home create flow (home-goal-create-flow.tsx:51-68). Never from ListGoalCard (list-goal-card.tsx:61-72).
assumptions.reason: Both flows open the same picker, so 'go back to the picker' means the same thing; the spec only forbids it for the direct list-page entry. Implemented as an optional onChangeList prop on GoalFormDialog, so ListGoalCard simply does not pass it.

assumptions.specRef: §2 'Збережи чинне підтвердження виходу зі зміненої форми'
assumptions.decision: 'Змінити список' goes through the existing useCloseGuard: a clean form returns to the picker at once; a dirty form opens the existing DiscardChangesDialog first, and confirming it returns to the picker.
assumptions.reason: Guard already exists (goal-form-dialog.tsx:109-115, 162; hooks/use-close-guard.ts). Leaving the form for the picker drops the draft just like closing does.

assumptions.specRef: §2 'Повернення відновлює пошук і фокус на виборі списку'
assumptions.decision: Search text is lifted out of PickerBody (goal-list-picker.tsx:155 local useState, lost when the dialog unmounts) into the flow owner and passed to GoalListPicker as a controlled value. On return, focus lands on the option of the previously chosen list; if that option is not rendered, on the search input.
assumptions.reason: Picker content unmounts when closed, so the state must live in the flow; 'фокус на виборі списку' read as the chosen list option.

assumptions.specRef: §2 'мінімальний read-only прогноз із повторним використанням серверної логіки'
assumptions.decision: New endpoint GET /api/lists/:listId/goal/preview?deadline=YYYY-MM-DD (deadline optional) returning { bookCount, countedCount }. Service: listsService.assertOwned, userSettingsContextService.calendar({ now, userId }) for today in the user timezone, readingGoalsRepository.findActiveListBooks (same scope as create, reading-goals.service.ts:85-88), a new read-only repository query for the earliest finished cycle per list book with the same predicates as findSnapshotProgress (reading-goal-books.repository.ts:215-227) keyed on listId/userId and readerDaySql(now), then selectQualifyingReadingGoalBooks (reading-goal-progress.ts:140-158) with goalStartDate = today and countingEndsAt = resolveReadingGoalCountingEnd({ archivedDay: null, deadline: deadline ?? today }) (reading-goal-window.ts:28-33). A provided deadline goes through inputValidator.assertFutureDeadline like create. No transaction, no writes.
assumptions.reason: FE has no finish dates for list books (CustomListCardSchema, packages/shared/src/lists.ts:76-84), so the count cannot be computed client-side. Deadline starts empty in the create form (goal-form.ts:98), so it must be optional to show the count before a deadline is picked; with it the rule is the exact create rule including the inclusive deadline.

assumptions.decision: Preview logic lives in a new application/reading-goal-creation-preview.service.ts, not in ReadingGoalsService.
assumptions.reason: One concern per file (CLAUDE.md §8.10); ReadingGoalsService is the write path (209 lines).

assumptions.decision: 'Ціль одразу стане виконаною' is derived on the client as countedCount >= targetCount from the watched form value; no refetch on target change.
assumptions.reason: Same rule as resolveReadingGoalStatus completedCount >= targetCount (reading-goal-progress.ts:131); the server count does not depend on the target.

assumptions.specRef: §2 'У стані помилки покажи загальне правило без непідтверджених чисел'
assumptions.decision: Loading: no number and no completion sentence (never a provisional 0). Error: only the existing general rule goals.form.explanation, already rendered at goal-form-dialog.tsx:409. countedCount 0: no preview message.
assumptions.reason: Spec wording; the general-rule copy already exists.

assumptions.decision: Action rendered inside GoalProgressHero under the bar, active goals only. Candidate = detail.remainingBooks[0] when its reading.status === 'reading' -> Link 'Продовжити читання' to /books/{id}; otherwise a button 'Переглянути книги цілі' that runs the existing remaining-books handler (goal-details-view.tsx:109-113: tab=books, scope=remaining, list focus).
assumptions.reason: Detail data is enough: ReadingGoalBookView carries reading.status (packages/shared/src/reading-goals.ts:219-227, 238); remainingBooks is sorted reading-first then by list position (reading-goal-books.service.ts:186-194) and capped at 100 (reading-goal.constants.ts:21), so truncation can never hide a reading book and index 0 is 'the first by list order'.

assumptions.specRef: §3 'Незавантажені або неповні дані не трактуй як відсутність кандидата'
assumptions.decision: No action while the detail query has no data (GoalDetailsView only renders with a loaded goal). The pure resolver takes the loaded detail only; there is no 'no candidate' result from a partial list because of A09 ordering.
assumptions.reason: Spec rule; ordering makes the preview list authoritative for the reading candidate.

assumptions.specRef: §3 'Головну пораду сформулюй природно… Для коротких інтервалів і стану без прогнозу використовуй відповідні наявні формати'
assumptions.decision: Advice from resolveGoalRateFigure over requiredBooksPerDay/requiredDaysPerBook (goal-pace-figures.ts:40-49). days_per_book with value >= 1: rounded to whole days (Math.round, min 1), copy goals.detail.hero.advice.daysPerBook (=1 -> 'щодня' form, same plural shape as overview.pace.daysPerBook). daysPerBook < 1: books-per-day format goals.detail.hero.advice.booksPerDay. missing: existing goals.detail.overview.pace.noData.
assumptions.reason: Server returns fractional daysPerBook (e.g. 3.7, reading-goal-metrics.test.ts:194); natural copy needs whole days. Existing short-interval and no-data formats are overview.pace.daysPerBook '=1', booksPerDay, noData.

assumptions.specRef: §3 'Залиши факт і план на шкалі… При відставанні не описуй його як частину книги в основному тексті'
assumptions.decision: Keep the legend (hero.actual, hero.plan, goal-progress-hero.tsx:94-108) and the pace badge (:142-144). Replace the gap sentence (gapText, :121-136, keys hero.gap.*) with the advice line. hero.gap.* keys are deleted from uk and en if no other reader remains.
assumptions.reason: hero.gap.behind/closeBehind print roundToTenth books, e.g. 'На 0,4 книги менше' (goal-pace-figures.ts:29-37).

assumptions.specRef: §3 'Додай явну дію «Усі цілі»… Посилання на джерельний список лишається в метаданих'
assumptions.decision: Header back link (goal-detail-header.tsx:47-61) always reads 'Усі цілі' and points to the catalog; the 'До списку «X»' variant is dropped from the header. The list link stays in GoalMeta (:74-90).
assumptions.reason: Spec names the list link's home as the metadata; one back target avoids two competing back actions.

assumptions.specRef: §3 'Після переходу з каталогу відновлюй статус, сортування та вигляд. Пряме відкриття деталей веде в каталог із типовими налаштуваннями'
assumptions.decision: Carry the catalog state in the detail URL as one search param 'catalog' holding the serialized catalog query (createSerializer(GOALS_QUERY_PARSERS), nuqs ^2.9.2). Detail reads it with the same parsers, so invalid values fall back to defaults; 'Усі цілі' href = '/goals' + that query. Links that carry it: catalog card and row titles (goal-catalog-card.tsx:225), overview highlights (goals-overview-highlights.tsx:82, 146), catalog create/active redirects (goals-catalog.tsx:59, 98). No param -> '/goals' with defaults.
assumptions.reason: Catalog state is URL-only via nuqs (goals-query.ts:19-23, use-goals-query.ts:28-31). A URL param survives reload and back/forward and makes a direct open default by construction; sessionStorage would leak an old catalog state into a direct open. No existing return-href helper in apps/web/src (grep returnTo|backHref: none).

assumptions.specRef: §4 'наявну ілюстрацію компактного розміру, орієнтовно 120–160 px… видимими на типовому десктопі без окремого прокручування'
assumptions.decision: Add EmptyState size xs = 'h-36 w-auto' (144 px) to ILLU_SIZE (components/empty-state.tsx:11-15) and to EmptyStateIllustrationSize (lib/empty-states.ts:37), plus an opt-in inline layout (image beside title, description and action from sm up, stacked below sm). Filtered empty uses empty-search at xs + inline. First-goal empty state keeps illuSize sm (224 px, goals-catalog-view.tsx:127-134).
assumptions.reason: Today filtered empty uses the default lg = h-84 = 336 px (empty-state.tsx:12, 32; goals-catalog-view.tsx:150-156). Estimated at 1280x800: shell 56 + header ~70 + KPI ~110 + highlights 0-150 + toolbar ~44 + gaps ~120 + py-6 + 336 px art puts the title at ~770-920 px and the button below the fold. EmptyState is a project component (CLAUDE.md §7), so it is extended in place.

assumptions.decision: active and expired filters keep the current generic title goals.catalog.filteredEmpty.title.
assumptions.reason: Spec names only archived and completed.

assumptions.decision: Caption and explanation are visible text in the KPI microfact (goals-overview.tsx:71-76), not a tooltip. Denominator wording: reached and overdue goals, archived ones included; active goals and goals archived before an outcome are not counted.
assumptions.reason: Radix tooltips do not open on touch. Formula: finished = result !== null (reading-goal-overview.service.ts:78), result is completed|expired only (reading-goal-progress.ts:108-119), archived goals keep a result when archived after reaching the target or after the deadline. Main loop confirmed on dev: finishedGoals 4 = 2 completed (one archived) + 2 expired.

assumptions.specRef: §3 example 'Щоб устигнути, дочитуй приблизно 1 книгу кожні 12 днів'
assumptions.decision: uk advice uses the formal 'дочитуйте' to match the app voice ('Оберіть', 'Поставте', 'Перевірте' in goals.*). Flip to 'дочитуй' if the maintainer wants the spec example verbatim.
assumptions.reason: Spec marks the sentence as an example ('наприклад'); the rest of goals.* is formal.

assumptions.decision: No change to the recording logic and no new regression test: main loop reproduced no bug on new events. Goal 588e2d47 history is unambiguous in replay: one planned change, activity 911be6bd completedCount 1 -> 2. Apply to dev/prod waits for a separate permission.
assumptions.reason: Spec §1 bullets 2-3; facts from the main loop.
